---
title: "Create Vendor"
api: "POST https://api.smartbills.io/v1/vendors"
description: "Create a new vendor/supplier"
---

## Overview

Create a new vendor to track suppliers for your company.

## Authentication

<ParamField header="Authorization" type="string" required>
  Bearer token for authentication
</ParamField>

## Required Scopes

- `vendors.write`

## Request Body

<ParamField body="name" type="string" required>
  Vendor's name
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="website" type="string" required>
  Vendor's website URL
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="logo" type="string">
  URL of vendor's logo
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="address" type="object">
  Vendor's address
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="email" type="string">
  Contact email
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="phoneNumber" type="string">
  Contact phone number
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="metadata" type="object">
  Custom metadata
</ParamField>

<RequestExample>

```bash cURL
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.smartbills.io/v1/vendors \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "name": "Acme Supplies Inc.",
    "website": "https://acmesupplies.com",
    "logo": "https://acmesupplies.com/logo.png",
    "email": "contact@acmesupplies.com",
    "phoneNumber": "+1-555-123-4567"
  }'
```

```javascript JavaScript
const vendor = await client.vendors.create({
  name: "Acme Supplies Inc.",
  website: "https://acmesupplies.com",
  logo: "https://acmesupplies.com/logo.png",
  email: "contact@acmesupplies.com",
  phoneNumber: "+1-555-123-4567"
});
```

```python Python
vendor = client.vendors.create(
    name="Acme Supplies Inc.",
    website="https://acmesupplies.com",
    logo="https://acmesupplies.com/logo.png",
    email="contact@acmesupplies.com",
    phone_number="+1-555-123-4567"
)
```

```csharp C#
var vendor = await client.Vendors.CreateAsync(new VendorCreateRequest
{
    Name = "Acme Supplies Inc.",
    Website = "https://acmesupplies.com",
    Logo = "https://acmesupplies.com/logo.png",
    Email = "contact@acmesupplies.com",
    PhoneNumber = "+1-555-123-4567"
});
```

</RequestExample>

```json Response
{
  "id": 12345,
```
